predefinedQueries.queryString: select af.* from entrasp.views_attachments_fast_no_bo af where codice_azienda=$codice_azienda$ and (id_risorsa=$id_risorsa$ or id_risorsa= (select id_risorsa from entrasp.cdms_risorse_oggetti ro where ro.nome_business_object='cdms_risorse' and ro.codice_azienda=$codice_azienda$ and replace(ro.chiave, ro.codice_azienda||'^', '')::numeric=$id_risorsa$ limit 1))
